title: This Desert Lizard Drinks Through Its Skin Using Tiny Grooves

scenes.text: This lizard drinks with its whole body.
The thorny devil lives in the Australian desert, where water is rare.
Tiny grooves between its spikes pull in dew, rain and damp sand.
The water creeps along the channels toward its mouth, even uphill.
No pumping. Just physics, called capillary action.
And it eats thousands of tiny ants in one day.

description:
The thorny devil collects water through grooves in its skin that carry it to its mouth by capillary action.
It eats thousands of ants in a day.
Would you want spikes like that?
first_comment: Which desert animal would you least want to survive like?
